newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE LEFT OUT OF AUSTRALIAN TEST SIDE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE LEFT OUT OF AUSTRALIAN TEST SIDE.

text.p: World record try scorer David Campese was omitted from the team to face Ireland on Saturday, when the Australian Test side was named on Wednesday.
Campese, who was dropped for the match against Scotland at Murrayfield 11 days ago, will be replaced at right wing by Jason Little, recently recovered from injury.
Australia have made four changes in all and two positional switches to the side which defeated Scotland.
Tim Horan moves to centre while Pat Howard is omitted and George Gregan takes over at scrum-half from Sam Payne.
In the pack Dan Crowley replaces the injured Richard Harry at loose-head and Daniel Manu moves from No 8 to blindside flanker replacing Owen Finegan. Michael Brial comes in at No 8.

Matthew Burke; Jason Little, Daniel Herbert, Tim Horan, Joe Roff; David Knox, George Gregan; Dan Crowley, Michael Foley, Andrew Blades, Warwick Waugh, John Eales (captain), Daniel Manu, David Wilson, Michael Brial.
